positive_findings: The exact M135r2 source set independently recompiles and reproduces the 96-vector, 8,832-lane PASS and all four nonzero SVA covers.
The sealed VCS input/output manifests and all 20 M135r3 DC evidence entries independently verify.
Both failed DC attempts are genuinely fail-closed with exit 35 and retained diagnostics; neither is safe to cite.
M135r3 postcompile check_design and check_timing are clean, with 12,732.048032 um2, 16,194 cells, 2,768 sequential cells, +0.5341 ns setup, no reported violations, and zero macros.
The contracts correctly keep physical_speedup, system_speedup, paper_ppa_ready and headline false.

findings.title: Assembler-rejected metadata still leaves a live bank-side request
findings.observation: Independent VCS attacks for idle continuation, unsupported width, premature last, and restart while collecting all produce protocol_error=1 with beat_ready/beat_accept/output_valid=0, yet simultaneously expose bank_use_mask=0xffff, bank_conflict_free=1 and nonzero bank addresses. The production SVA's all-traffic quarantine property does not include bank-side outputs.
findings.impact: If bank_use_mask/address are connected to macro read enables/address pins, malformed protocol traffic can still consume SRAM activity and energy despite the advertised fail-closed traffic interface. This is a real integration boundary defect, though it does not invalidate the existing valid-vector numeric results.
findings.required_fix: Add a state-aware metadata predecoder ahead of mapper_request_valid for every error decidable without SRAM data; generate an explicit bank_request_valid/read_enable only from that precheck. Extend SVA so metadata-decidable protocol_error implies bank_request_valid=0, bank_use_mask=0, bank_row_addresses=0 and conflict_free=0. Retain a separate rule for final-padding errors that inherently require returned data, then rerun the four independent attacks plus randomized state/protocol attacks.

findings.title: The zero-latency bank-data port cut cannot establish executable SRAM cycles or physical speedup
findings.observation: M135 has combinational bank_words for the current logical_base_word but no bank request ready/valid, response valid, response tag, latency or stale/skew detection. The DC cut contains zero of the sixteen 230x32 SRAM macros and ignores bank wiring.
findings.impact: The exact 2/2/2/3 values are accepted input start intervals under an always-ready zero-latency 512-bit service abstraction. A synchronous macro can add request/response stages, bubbles, tag storage and wide routing; therefore current evidence cannot support kernel, physical, full-network or system acceleration.
findings.required_fix: Build a minimal tagged SRAM shim rather than a global scheduler: explicit request_valid/ready and request identity, configurable one-or-more-cycle macro response valid/tag, response buffering, stale/skew rejection and output backpressure. Drive the frozen vector cohort through 1-cycle, realistic macro-latency and stressed-stall modes, then synthesize with the exact sixteen macros and matched baseline.

findings.title: Flattened mapped logic has no independent RTL-to-netlist equivalence seal
findings.observation: The functional VCS seal is on RTL and M135r3 flattens all hierarchy before mapping. No Formality completion or post-map equivalence receipt is frozen for the r3 DDC/netlist.
findings.impact: DC is internally consistent and check_design is clean, but publication-grade evidence cannot independently connect the exact VCS semantics to the flattened netlist.
findings.minimal_fix: Run exact-SHA Formality from the M135r2 RTL/source contract to the M135r3 SVF/DDC or mapped netlist, fail closed on unmatched or aborted points, and pin the completion receipt into the DC admission overlay.

findings.title: Timing closure has effectively zero reported hold margin and no routing model
findings.observation: The hold report rounds the worst paths to +0.0000 ns, while the run uses ideal clock and ZeroWireload over a 1,907-port, wide-bus top. DC also reports 41 logic levels on the worst setup path and high-fanout warnings.
findings.impact: The literal no-violation gate passes, but the number is not robust physical margin and cannot be used as Fmax or post-route timing evidence.
findings.minimal_fix: After the SRAM shim freezes, run macro-aware topographical/physical synthesis and PT with propagated clock and extracted/interconnect estimates; require explicit setup and hold guard bands rather than rounded zero.

findings.title: The second failed-DC correction does not self-pin its failed evidence
findings.observation: The r1 correction pins the failed marker and report hashes, while the r2 correction names the run and metrics but omits the failed marker and report SHA values. The r3 contract pins the r2 correction, not the r2 failed evidence directly.
findings.impact: The on-disk fail-closed chain is independently recoverable and this review anchors it, but the production supersession record is less immutable than r1.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a non-mutating supersession overlay that pins the r2 failed marker SHA 02bfccdd..., check_design SHA 2244ad13..., and diagnostic report hashes; continue prohibiting citation of all r1/r2 metrics.

findings.title: Flattening improvement and 2/2/2/3 are not acceleration results
findings.observation: Relative to the failed same-RTL hierarchical r2 diagnostic, r3 flattening reduces logic area by 3.401335% and cells by 4.802775%, keeps 2,768 sequential cells, and improves setup slack by 0.0570 ns. The r2 run failed check_design, so these values are diagnostic only. No matched dense/eight-bank/alternative frontend baseline is measured at the same macro, clock and workload.
findings.impact: Neither the flatten delta nor service-beat geometry supplies a speedup numerator/denominator. Claiming 2-3x, Fmax, FPS, full-network or system speedup would cross the frozen boundary.
findings.minimal_fix: Choose and freeze a matched baseline, count request-to-output cycles including macro latency and stalls for both designs, and report latency, throughput, area, energy and area/energy efficiency separately. Use Amdahl composition only after the module's ordered-trace share is measured.

ordered_actions: Repair and assert metadata-decidable bank-request quarantine, then rerun the four independent attacks.
Add the minimal tagged SRAM latency shim and behavioral macro model; do not wait for a global scheduler.
Run exact-SHA Formality on the unchanged repaired RTL to flattened mapped netlist.
Run matched macro-inclusive baseline/candidate cycles and PPA; preserve 2/2/2/3 as service geometry until then.
Add a small supersession overlay pinning the r2 failed-run marker/report hashes.
claim_boundary: M135r3 is admissible only as commercial-VCS functional composition plus flattened standard-cell logic-only DC at a zero-latency bank-data port cut. It is not a macro-complete module, physical accelerator, speedup result, system result, DATE headline or best-paper result.
